database.name: hlif-cuda-registry
database.description: CUDA kernel registry for H-LIF family neuron models. Metadata for each kernel: mathematical reference, hyperparameters, design constraints, project usage, cross-reference to FPGA database, patent provenance. The .cu and .py implementations live in cuda/kernels/ and cuda/wrappers/ respectively.
database.affiliation: İstinye University, Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering

structure_notes.kernels: Raw CUDA C source (.cu) under cuda/kernels/. Canonical version, human-readable, version-controlled.
structure_notes.wrappers: Python autograd Function + nn.Module wrappers (.py) under cuda/wrappers/. Kernel source embedded inline for self-containment in Colab. Must stay in sync with the canonical .cu.
structure_notes.cross_reference: model_name values match entries in fpga/measurements.json (same neuron model, software speed vs hardware energy).

math.membrane_update: v_next = beta*v + I_in - spike*V_th (leaky + soft reset)
math.note: Natural hazard gradient is analytic, no surrogate function needed.

learnability.hazard_parameters: FIXED at init time in this kernel
learnability.note: Learnable hazard parameters reserved for L-TH-LIF (separate kernel, to be added). This kernel matches PP-SNN v4 and battery SoH paper conventions.

design_constraints: Tensor shape (B, T, N) row-major mandatory
CUDA device required, no CPU fallback
Reset gradient breaking active (gv=0 after spike, BPTT does not cross spike events)
Exponent clamped to [-10, 10] in forward, dp/dv clamped to [0, 2], gs clamped to [-1, 1]

performance_characteristics.memory_complexity: O(B*T*N) per direction (spk + dp_dv saved for backward)

used_in_projects.name: Dolphin SNN Paper 1 (PP-SNN v4)
used_in_projects.role: click pathway ICI stage (deferred to Paper 2)

used_in_projects.name: Battery SoH paper R2 (TH-LIF expert encoder)

cross_reference_fpga.note: Same neuron model. fpga/measurements.json has hardware energy/resource numbers (171 LUTs, 240 pJ/step upper bound on Arty A7-35T). This registry has software speed numbers. Both reference the same mathematical formulation.

patent.primary_status: filed 14.05.2026 (neuron family, liquid extension, N-island MoE)
patent.note: TH-LIF as a neuron model is covered by 2026/007632 (claim 2). The hybrid SoC system that uses TH-LIF as a neuromorphic watchdog is covered by 2026/004809.

_template_new_kernel._aciklama: Yeni nöron kernel'i eklerken bu template'i kernels dict'ine yeni anahtarla ekle. Önce cuda/kernels/<id>.cu ve cuda/wrappers/<id>.py dosyalarını oluştur.
